resources.string: Home screen, dock and app drawer sizes
Using the default for this phone: %1$d × %2$d
Same number of icons as columns
Changing the home screen or dock size clears your home screen and dock so you can start fresh. Changing only the app drawer columns keeps everything.
Home screen preview: %1$d columns, %2$d rows, %3$d dock icons

Changing the grid removes every shortcut, folder and widget from your home screen and dock, so you can set it up fresh at the new size. Your apps stay installed and in the app drawer.\n\nThis can\'t be undone.
Your home screen is locked. Unlock it in Home settings to change its size.
Shortcuts, folders and widgets on the home screen and dock can\'t be moved, removed or added. Apps still open and their menus still work.
Home screen is locked. Unlock it in Home settings.
